calculation.description: Cross-sectional short-term three-day reversal combined with a modest positive medium-term twenty-day trend term. Each component is cross-sectionally standardized daily using only information through the observation date. Higher values favor recent losers with supportive medium-term trend.

validation.regime_notes: Validated across 2,482 daily cross-sectional observations and all 15 tradable benchmark instruments; conservative interpretation warranted because the universe is small despite broad coverage. Positive IC and ICIR persist at 5- and 10-day horizons.
